narrative: The in-the-wild Langflow IDOR and AutoGPT SSRF show agent-platform plumbing shipping unsafe-by-default and hardening only after a maximum-severity incident, the same default-shipment pressure the safe-artifact-handling prediction (Jun 17) expects to reach managed model-serving platforms. But both are authorization-bypass and request-forgery flaws, not the unsafe-deserialization class (pickle, dill, model checkpoints) that defines this bar, so the contact stays thematic.
remaining_gap: No deserialization incident and no managed-platform default change today; no named platform flipping safe artifact handling on by default has been disclosed.
